gloss: fond of cleanliness; neat freak; tidy person

definitions.gloss: fond of cleanliness; neat freak; tidy person
definitions.explanation: a personality trait describing someone who likes things to be clean and orderly

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{綺麗好|きれいず}きだ。
{綺麗好|きれいず}きな{人|ひと}と{暮|く}らすのは{気|き}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Living with a tidy person requires being careful.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{綺麗好|きれいず}きで、{家|いえ}の{中|なか}にはいつも{花|はな}が{飾|かざ}ってある。
examples.english: My mother likes things neat, so there are always flowers arranged in the house.

notes:
A compound noun used as a personality descriptor. Can be used both positively (someone who keeps things nice) and with a hint of exasperation (someone overly particular about cleanliness). Functions as both a noun (a neat person) and a na-adjective modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綺麗好|きれいず}きな{人|ひと}: a tidy/clean person
- {綺麗好|きれいず}きな{性格|せいかく}: a tidy personality
- かなりの{綺麗好|きれいず}き: quite the neat freak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潔癖症|けっぺきしょう}: germaphobe, obsessive cleanliness — much stronger, implies a disorder
- {几帳面|きちょうめん}: meticulous, precise — broader than just cleanliness, includes punctuality and organization

FORMS:
{綺麗|きれい} (clean, beautiful) + {好|ず}き (fond of). Same pattern as {寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}, {怖|こわ}がり, {甘党|あまとう}, etc. — personality words built from preferences.
